objectives.title: Processor Breach Notification Timing
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions regarding processor notification to the controller upon detecting security incidents.
criteria: Requirement to notify the controller after becoming aware of a personal data breach.
Timeline specifying notification occurs without undue delay.

objectives.title: Breach Details Disclosure
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions regarding specific details supplied regarding an incident.
criteria: Details describing the nature of the personal data breach.
Estimates of affected data subject categories.
Estimates of affected data subject counts.
Categories of personal data records affected.
Estimates of affected personal data record counts.

objectives.title: Contact Point Designation
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions designating communication channels for security incidents.
criteria: Designation of a specific contact point for incident inquiries.
Contact details for the designated incident responder.
Identification details for the data protection officer.

objectives.title: Breach Impact Assessment
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions regarding the evaluation of breach ramifications.
criteria: Descriptions of likely consequences resulting from the breach.
Explanations of potential risks to individuals.

objectives.title: Mitigation Measure Reporting
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions regarding corrective actions taken in response to a breach.
criteria: Descriptions of measures implemented to address the breach.
Proposals for actions to mitigate adverse effects.

objectives.title: Phased Breach Reporting
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions allowing staggered disclosures during complex investigations.
criteria: Allowance for incremental delivery of incident information.
Commitment to furnish updates without undue further delay.
Procedures for communicating subsequent discoveries.

objectives.title: Breach Documentation Support
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions regarding recording incident evidence.
criteria: Obligation to log facts relating to the personal data breach.
Obligation to record effects of the incident.
Obligation to maintain records of remedial actions taken.
Documentation maintained in a form that enables the supervisory authority to verify compliance.
